PRINCIPLE: Test should focus on a single behavior. RATIONALE: Single Arrange-Act-Assert block improves diagnosis. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for number of distinct Act operations. DECISION RULES: 1) Count Act operations; only object construction present (one act). 2) Test name not explicitly indicating multiple operations. 3) One method call and single group -> compliant. VERDICT: compliant because the method performs a single operation (new Ordenacao()) and contains a single, simple arrange/act block.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be independent. RATIONALE: Independence allows arbitrary execution order. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for @Before/@After or shared mutable state. DECISION RULES: 1) No @Before/@After found. 2) No static/instance mutable state modified in this method. 3) Tests use only local variables -> compliant. VERDICT: compliant because the test uses only a local variable and does not rely on shared state or ordering.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Provide happy path and error scenario tests. RATIONALE: Ensures robustness by testing exceptions. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Need at least two test methods (happy + error) for the behavior. DECISION RULES: 1) Count test methods in class; only one test method present -> non-compliant. 2) No @Test(expected=...) or assertThrows present in the class for this behavior. VERDICT: non-compliant because the class contains only a single test method and no tests for error/exceptional flows.

PRINCIPLE: Validate inputs at boundaries. RATIONALE: Boundaries find off-by-one/range errors. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for tests of empty/zero/negative/MAX values. DECISION RULES: The tested code is only a constructor call with no input parameters; the method under test has no obvious numeric/string boundaries. VERDICT: not-applicable because the test does not exercise input domains with boundaries.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be modular and reusable. RATIONALE: Helper methods reduce duplication. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for helper methods, constants or very short tests. DECISION RULES: No helpers/constants found but the test is very short (<10 lines) and does not repeat code -> compliant. VERDICT: compliant because the single short test is self-contained and not duplicated.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Keep tests small and low-complexity. RATIONALE: Simpler tests reduce bugs. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Tests <20 lines, no loops/conditionals.
